annotations.title: Continue a purchase made with buy_proxy

description: Takes no payment. Continues a purchase made with buy_proxy from its receipt, and can be repeated at any time: it says whether the payment is confirmed, rents the proxy that was paid for once ipvolt has confirmed the payment on chain (usually within a few minutes), never above the price that was paid and never twice, and then gives the connection details (host, ports, username, password), which are secrets. The receipt is a secret too. Needs no account and no credential.

receipt.description: The receipt buy_proxy returned, copied exactly. A secret: whoever has it can use the purchase.
